senses.gloss: f. (נָתַץ) cutting out, breaking up. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 8, ch. X את שיש לו נ׳ that which can be broken up (brick-work &c.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:1:2">Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ</cite> top <he>נ׳ נ׳ מבית המנוגע</he> the breaking up of idolatrous structures (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 12:3">Deut. XII, 3</cite>) is analogous to the breaking up of leprous buildings (<cite ref="Leviticus 14:45">Lev. XIV, 45</cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 3:3:3">Y. Orl. III, 63ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דכתיב נ׳ נ׳</he> for the term <cite ref="N01386"><he>נתץ</he></cite> is used for idolatry and for levitical purity (<cite ref="Leviticus 11:35">Lev. XI, 35</cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:10">Tosef. Neg. VI, 10</cite>, contrad. to <cite ref="H01060"><he>חליצה</he></cite> the removal of one affected stone. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 10 <he>נטיעה שאין בה נ׳</he> a putting up not to be followed by a tearing down.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:2:3">Y. Orl. I, 60ᵈ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="N01045"><he>נְפִיצָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:4:11">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
